source: Quality-v1 TRAIN-only dynamic EXIT discovery; preregistered three-rule family and selection protocol
expected_direction: mean paired PnL change > 0 versus frozen FOLLOW HOLD on intended SELL positions
definition: Exit FOLLOW virtual SELL at the first open-trade snapshot where ha_direction == +1 (opposite the SELL position). Other FOLLOW BUY and all INVERT paths remain the baseline.

family_examined_on_TRAIN.HA_AND_STOCH_OPPOSITE: first snapshot where both component rules are true

selection_rule: Among the three frozen rules, choose the largest mean paired PnL change for FOLLOW virtual SELL at 250 ms; exact ties follow rule order HA_OPPOSITE, STOCH_KD_OPPOSITE, HA_AND_STOCH_OPPOSITE.
execution: First quote strictly after the decision-arrival quote plus latency; frozen TP=240, SL=180 and TIME_EXIT=100 have precedence.
missing_handling: A missing HA value does not trigger an exit.
walk_forward_criterion: At least 70% positive expanding purged TRAIN folds and no fold contributes more than 50% of aggregate positive intended-side change.
failure_criterion: Reject before Discovery Validation if the predefined walk-forward consistency or concentration gate fails.
